name: KGI Financial Holding Co Ltd
summary: KGI Financial Holding Co., Ltd. provides a diverse array of financial services, primarily encompassing commercial banking, securities trading, and venture capital investments. Its operational structure is organized into several key divisions: Commercial Banking, Securities, Venture Capital, Insurance, and an "Other" category. The company strategically allocates capital to an extensive range of financial entities, including financial holding firms, banks, credit card providers, bills finance houses, trust and insurance companies, securities brokerages, futures brokerages, venture capital enterprises, and foreign financial institutions. This firm was established on December 28, 2001, and maintains its principal headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.
